questionSnapshot.question: The songwriting duo Kristen Anderson-Lopez and Robert Lopez wrote the songs for which Disney film?

notes: Read all four options, full matching topic digests and cross-bank comparisons; checked wording, category, editorial difficulty and main-film scope. Challenged Moana and Brave rather than relying on absence in a Frozen synopsis. Their music teams are explicitly different in the primary introductions/press release; Encanto has Miranda original songs. Frozen stage source expressly identifies original film songs separately from stage additions.

verification.context: The songwriting duo Kristen Anderson-Lopez and Robert Lopez wrote the songs for which Disney film?

premise.reason: Licensed rights-holder description explicitly attributes the original Frozen film songs to the pair.

sources.locator: Opening description explicitly identifies the original animated film songs as by Kristen Anderson-Lopez and Robert Lopez, separately from new stage songs.
Intro text explicitly names Mark Mancina, Lin-Manuel Miranda and Opetaia Foa’i as the Moana music team; text inspected, not unplayed video.
